title: Fix shebang position in cli.ts after license header addition
body:
PR #102 added MIT license headers to all source files, but placed them above the shebang in `packages/cli/src/cli.ts`, causing build failure. Shebangs must be on line 1 to function.

## Changes

- **packages/cli/src/cli.ts**: Moved `#!/usr/bin/env node` to line 1, license header follows immediately after

## Before/After

```typescript
// Before (broken)
/**
 * ObjectUI
 * Copyright (c) 2024-present ObjectStack Inc.
 * ...
 */

#!/usr/bin/env node
import { Command } from 'commander';

// After (fixed)
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * ObjectUI
 * Copyright (c) 2024-present ObjectStack Inc.
 * ...
 */
import { Command } from 'commander';
```

This resolves the TypeScript error `TS18026: '#!' can only be used at the start of a file` that broke the Bundle Size Check workflow.
